_description: Careers pages for the firms on the Target Company List that have a known URL (from the Job Tracker project's Careers_Sources files, scans of 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-10). 'ats' is auto-detected from the URL (scripts/detect-ats.cjs); 'system' is what the scan found. Many firms are only 'custom-careers': the real ATS shows up behind the Apply button. Add firms with: node scripts/add-source.cjs company "Firm" --url <careers url>. The other ~690 firms live in the Firm Database (see docs/job-sources.md).
